identity.name: DDMRV: AppPort resolver across capability versions
identity.description: Discover, Diagnose, Modify, Recover, Verify on a real repository defect: AppPort @ 268c9b4 resolves a requirement against only the lowest version a provider serves. The coding-benchmark-v1 T4 fixture (Stack-Agent repository), with a transient test-infrastructure failure as the default obstacle.

objective.goal:
AppPort dependency resolution across capability versions (TypeScript, pnpm, vitest). Make application dependency resolution correct for providers that serve more than one version of the same capability, as the specification allows.
Problem: a provider application registers invoice.create at version 1 and version 2. A consumer requires invoice.create with version constraint "2" (or "^2"). Resolution reports it unresolved or incompatible, saying the provider's version 1 does not satisfy the constraint, though that provider offers version 2. Open-ended constraints such as ">=1" resolve, but not to the version users expect from the resolver's documented selection rule. A requirement for exactly version 1 works.
Requirements: read spec/appport-1.0.md, spec/dependencies-1.md and the core resolver and registry first. Reproduce the failure against the starting commit with a test that fails there. Fix the responsible layer so compatibility, provider-pinned resolution and resolution across several candidate providers agree on which provided version satisfies a requirement. Keep the existing selection rules between providers (lifecycle preference, the ambiguous outcome) and result shapes. Add regression tests through the public @appport/core API. No manifest, wire-protocol or public API changes; no unrelated refactors.
Acceptance: a provider serving several versions is compatible with a requirement for any version it serves and incompatible when none satisfies it; exact, range and provider-pinned requirements resolve to the version they ask for under the documented selection rule; single-version providers resolve as before; existing suite passes (pnpm test); new tests fail without the fix. Do not commit or push. Report the reproduction and output, root cause, changed files, tests and results, and limitations.

interruption.description: The harness SIGKILLs the agent's process group after its 3rd model call and relaunches it with the same task id (Stack-Agent resume) once its lease expires.

regression.knownFlakyNote: freePort() probes then closes a port before the Python provider binds it; under parallel vitest workers another server can take the port and the test sees a different manifest (`tickets.list@1 not declared`). Passed 3/3 at the base on 2026-10-28 (docs/harness/runs/course-001-base-regression-determinism.json). If only known-flaky files fail, the suite is run once more and the rerun is scored (both recorded).

scoring.outcome: PASS iff regression passes, the hidden acceptance passes and no critical violation completed; FAIL otherwise when the agent ran; BLOCKED when the attempt could not start for reasons outside the agent; ERROR for harness/evaluator faults; CANCELLED when cancelled. The agent's claim never changes the outcome.
